title: dryopteris pallida
intro: Dryopteris pallida, commonly known as the pale buckler fern, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dryopteris pallida include its potential to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
